id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cef: "Sorry, I didn't think of Erik's feelings... I spoke too much all at once.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cf6: "Everyone, please look after Erik. He can't have gone far. I'll follow after.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d1f: "You never know what will happen. Prepare well before heading out.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dc2: "Yggdrasil may fall, the Gold Plague may spread, whatever happens, we have no choice but to do business. Now then...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2def: "Traveler, it must be quite cold outside town. Buy the armor we sell. It'll block some of the cold.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3163: "The Vikings have always been drinkers and regulars here. I hope business picks up.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3189: "How strange... the stew I was simmering at home had frozen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3192: "Annoying, but I have to buy vegetables for the stew again.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31a0: "This and... that... oh, I need this too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b3: "This and... that... oh, I need this too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31a4: "Haa, the frozen stew caused unexpected expenses. My precious savings will be gone.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b8: "Haa, my kids eat so much it caused unexpected expenses. My precious savings will be gone.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31c6: "My kids love stew. They want it every day, which is a trouble.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31d5: "I want to feed my kids warm stew, but the Gold Plague means no ingredients.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31e2: "We cooperate to make do, but at this rate our lives won't hold up for long.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31f1: "I'm glad the Gold Plague is gone and fresh ingredients are available again like before.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31fe: "Now I can feed my kids warm stew. Tonight I'll put my all into cooking.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|320c: "Eating warm stew with family and sleeping in a warm bed together... Maybe that's happiness.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329f: "Ancient people, like us, seem to have made accurate calendars from celestial movements.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32b1: "Come to think of it, I heard Gallopolis's wasteland has ruins built by ancient people to observe stars.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3310: "The Luminary's star suddenly fell... There must be a great meaning. I'll write a paper and debut at the academic society.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3362: "Geez... the professor always nags me to store books properly. Delivering these will get me scolded again.

tm.「大樹が落ちようと 黄金病が広まろうと\n たとえ 何が起ころうとも\n ワシら: "Yggdrasil may fall, the Gold Plague may spread, whatever happens, we have no choice but to do business. Now then...

tm.「クレイモラン王国へ ようこそ！\n あんた この国の美しい町並みを\n 見物し: "Welcome to the Kingdom of Sniflheim! You came to see our beautiful townscape, right?
